character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every scene: pale silver hair in a long straight cut, reflective pale-blue eyes, with a distinct recognizable face and stable adult proportions. Their role in this world: a remote landscape photographer searching for perfect reflections across the salt flats. Signature outfit: a sand-white windbreaker, pale grey layered travel clothes, and sun-protective boots. Defining personal object: a compact mirrorless camera with a mirrored lens cap. Preserve the same face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, costume silhouette, and personal object throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist as the sole lead throughout this theme.
Maintain consistent facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature costume and defining object visually identical from scene to scene.
Do not replace the lead or add another protagonist unless explicitly demanded by the lyrics.
